_how_to_use: Pointers plus bidder scope language. OPEN the scope narrative, the spec sections and the sheets -- do not draft from this record's titles alone. Do NOT enumerate drawings in the exhibit; the sheet lists here tell you what to read, not what to write.
document_authority_hierarchy: 1. Addenda & Clarifications supersede everything they touch. Addendum #1 (05.06.26) reissued G0-00, LS1-10, A1-20, A2-10, A10-30, C1 and GD. Exhibit B Basis of GMP (07.01.26) is a contract document treated as an addendum (PM ruling 08.04.26).
2. The Scope of Work narrative decides WHICH PACKAGE carries an item. It is the trade-boundary authority.
3. Specifications decide HOW the work is executed.
4. Drawings show extent and location. Weakest authority for assignment.

Subcontractor proposals are NOT in this hierarchy. They surface the assumptions a bidder made and expose gaps. Where a proposal contradicts a contract document, FLAG it -- never silently adopt the proposal's position or narrow the subcontract to match it. Ignore general/boilerplate exclusions.

bidders.current_document: SUBCONTRACTOR FILES/21.0 - Subcontractor Proposals/Other Proposals/070 Final Cleaning - Lady Lux.pdf.txt
inclusions: LadyLux™ Cleaning Company shall provide two mobilizations for final construction cleaning
services associated with the new concessions/restroom building, press box, and ticket booth at
the NCSD Tonopah High School Sports Field Replacement project.
Construction Clean – Scheduled 8/27/27
Construction cleaning shall include detailed removal of construction dust, debris, labels,
adhesive residue, and trade-related buildup from interior surfaces throughout the concessions
building, public restrooms, press box, and ticket booth. Scope includes cleaning of doors,
frames, hardware, glazing, mirrors, counters, partitions, plumbing fixtures, restroom
accessories, lockers, wall surfaces, equipment exteriors, lighting, diffusers, and accessible
horizontal surfaces. Floors shall be vacuumed, swept, and damp mopped as appropriate to floor
finish conditions. Interior and accessible exterior glass shall be cleaned.
Final Clean – Scheduled 9/10/27
Final cleaning shall include re-cleaning and detailing of all previously cleaned areas prior to
owner turnover. Scope includes final dust removal, restroom detailing, glazing polish, touch-up
cleaning from punch activity, fixture detailing, floor detailing, and final presentation cleaning
throughout the concessions building, public restrooms, press box, and ticket booth to prepare
the facility for occupancy and use.
